visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a dark grey jacket and glasses stands on a wooden platform. Behind him, a grey tent is pitched under trees with pink cherry blossoms. A small wooden hut with glass windows stands to the left. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) A white corner bathtub is positioned inside a room with dark wood walls. Through the adjacent glass window, green bamboo stalks are densely packed. A grey bath mat lies on the floor. (3) From a car's perspective, the camera follows a winding gravel road. Outside the window, rolling green mountains are visible under a thick layer of grey clouds. A wooden railing and a small brown shack appear in the foreground. (4) A close-up of a wooden building with a corrugated metal roof. A large white bathtub is visible inside through the glass. The structure is built on a wooden deck elevated over a slope with lush greenery. (5) The man points to the mountains from the wooden deck. The background shows a deep valley with layers of green hills and some fog. The lighting is soft and overcast. (6) Inside the hut, a small two-door silver refrigerator stands under a wooden shelf holding a mirror and a white hair dryer. A white toilet with an electronic bidet seat is located nearby. (7) Hands with clear nails carefully pour steaming hot water from a grey kettle into a white drip coffee filter sitting atop a grey metal mug. (8) A person is seen in silhouette sitting on a black folding chair on the wooden deck at dusk, looking out over the hazy mountain ranges. (9) A close-up shows a small heater with a glowing orange flame inside a glass and metal cage. A hand reaches towards the top of the heater to test the warmth. (10) At night, the man lies in the white bathtub with a small patterned towel on his head. A glowing lantern and a larger heater sit on the wooden floor nearby, providing warm artificial light. (11) A white carbon monoxide detector is mounted on the wooden wall, followed by a close-up of its 'KIDDE' logo and digital display.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 獨立景觀浴缸廁所 熱水洗手台 一帳包場的營地. [Subtitle]: 今天來到一個超級誇張的營地. (2) [Subtitle]: 營區有景觀大浴缸 自己的喔~ 太誇張了. (3) [Subtitle]: 到了到了到了 你看看 有多遼闊~ 超扯超扯. [Subtitle]: 珮珮下車囉. (4) [Subtitle]: 你看看你看看 VIP區的超美風景. (5) [Subtitle]: 然後最扯的是什麼 浴缸 寶貝妳看我就是要帶妳來這 讚不讚 讚 很讚對不對. (6) [Subtitle]: 會不會被別人看到 我也不知道欸. (7) [Subtitle]: 景觀浴缸. (8) [Subtitle]: 嗨 要洗澡給我看嗎 你會被抓走. (9) [Subtitle]: 然後這邊是吹頭髮、冰箱、廁所 欸它還有免治馬桶欸. (10) [Subtitle]: 現在把酒精爐上面放濾茶器 燒紅 金屬燒熱 它熱產生熱對流 轉換成熱輻射 現在上面就會很溫暖. (11) [Subtitle]: 因為怕這個洗澡間太冷 把大暖爐給搬過來 小暖爐這邊也都還在點 超讚的. (12) [Subtitle]: 以前我對浴缸還好 自從我的背痛、脖子痛久了之後 加上我們家沒浴缸 我現在對浴缸越來越有願望. (13) [Subtitle]: 不過現在外面是烏漆墨黑的 打開窗簾也看不到東西 比較可惜一點 所以明天早上再來泡一次啊 可以呀 覺明天早上泡會被人家看光. (14) [Subtitle]: 這邊是一氧化碳偵測器 因為在裡面點了兩個暖爐 所以一氧化碳偵測器很重要.
